cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the cast on. That tape you wanted removed is holding the curtain up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said it looked untidy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay here and watch it. Tell them whose untidy repair saved the finale.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm thanking the whole crew. We don't single people out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the crew thanks. Just add 'including the one I told to take the tape down.'

reason: Make A manage the cast and take monitoring duty; B inclusive-thanks policy changes A request to a specific addition rather than replacement.
